summary.text: Scott Cupps is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 158 since January 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Chris Foster is also on the general election ballot for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Cupps was assigned to the House Administration and Accounts, Budget, Fiscal Review and Transportation committees for 2025-2026, and served as vice-chair of the Joint Committee on Legislative Research.
In earlier terms he served on committees including Emerging Issues, Administrative Oversight, Conservation and Natural Resources and House Economic Development (2021-2022).
